## History

Fred Wright entered into a secret romance with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovered the two together in the garden during the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding. Following this revelation, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shared the news of her engagement to Fred with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P13](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0013), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P17](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0017), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), +146 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright is romantically involved with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and the two become engaged to be married. Their secret romance is eventually discovered by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a garden. Shortly afterward, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her official engagement to Fred.

- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) act as comrades who travel together to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate news. They share a social circle through their mutual connections in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and community events.

- Comrade of — traveling together to Green Gables to investigate news  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>
